oracle.independence_basis: Exact rational recomputation (fractions.Fraction) of every numeric value from the declared scenario inputs: misclassification-corrected prevalence (0.41+0.8-1)/(0.9+0.8-1)=0.3, inverse-variance pool 0.15 / 0.0002, covariance-aware generalized-least-squares pool 0.15 / 0.0003 by explicit 2x2 inversion, row-overlap counts from the declared row spans, composed risks, excess risk, aligned product-lattice mean and decision utilities before and after the revision. The generator reads only the scenario block of expected.json and recomputes values, revised_values and the overlap pool in exact rational arithmetic; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package, and the covariance-aware pool is solved by explicit 2x2 inversion rather than by the product's pooling routine. The shared object is the fixture README's modelling statement (risk-difference composition, prevalence-weighted risk, utility = benefit*excess - cost): a misreading common to the README and the generator would not be detected.
asserted_outputs: pooled estimate and variance (disjoint and overlapping evidence)
composed outcome risks and excess risk before and after the revision
decision utilities and selected action before and after the revision
context_only_outputs: refusal/mutation/conversion/variant code and detail strings (product contract labels)
oracle.historical_exposure: Written during this review from the fixture README and scenario inputs; the executing assertion was read to establish which values it compares; no product implementation source was consulted. Who first derived the hand arithmetic is unrecorded.
